findings.issue: needs-human: Issue #28 requires versioned BrowserCapabilityObservation, BrowserCapabilityRequest, BrowserCapabilityLease and BrowserLeaseReceipt schemas. Only unversioned lease/takeover/ReturnReceipt examples exist; task/environment identity, requested versus granted scope, purpose, shared-auth classification, effect references and verification results are missing. Agree the public contract names, versions and fields before implementing them.

needs-human: ACTIVE cannot distinguish CONNECTED_READONLY from CONTROL_ACTIVE or represent UNKNOWN/UNSUPPORTED capability. The lifecycle does not define per-action TTL/revocation and execution-bound replay checks, queued/in-flight action fencing, or fresh observation and old DOM-reference invalidation after takeover. TAKEN_OVER terminates a lease without a corresponding mandatory return-evidence path. Agree these states and whether continuation replaces or renews the lease.

needs-human: click/fill grants have no independent #12 ExternalEffectSpec decision boundary or mandatory pre-effect handoff for login/OTP/CAPTCHA/payment/send/delete/publish. ACTION_ATTEMPTED/EFFECT_CONFIRMED/EFFECT_UNKNOWN and canonical confirmation before retrying an ambiguous submit are absent. Agree effect-policy and receipt integration; a browser lease cannot imply effect or duplicate-submit authorization.

needs-human: ReturnReceipt permits only RETURNED/EXPIRED/REVOKED with ambientAuthorityDropped=true, so a disconnected bridge or missing runtime evidence cannot be represented honestly. Issue #28 requires UNKNOWN when release cannot be verified. Adding UNKNOWN and a verification result changes the proposed receipt API.

needs-human: Correcting the hostname example does not define scheme/port/subdomain matching or metadata-only evidence rules. The adjacent comment allows URL information without excluding sensitive query/body data, and the secret prohibition does not cover logs or artifacts referenced by evidenceRefs. Agree scope matching and evidence handling, including rejection of page/trace instructions that widen origin/action/credential scope.

needs-human: Five fixture names are prose only; no executable synthetic browser/profile fixtures, read-only inventory or evidence mapping were delivered. Required sibling-tab/profile denial, read-only control rejection, stale/revoked replay, takeover freshness, protected-effect denial, injection and ambiguous-submit behavior remain untested. These research artifacts depend on the unresolved contracts; static document regressions cannot establish browser enforcement.

FIXED: originAllowlist contained github.com, a hostname that cannot be parsed as an absolute origin. The example now uses https://github.com. A regression checks that the example contains nonempty canonical origins without credentials/path/query/fragment; it fails with ERR_ASSERTION on the reviewed document and passes after this one-line correction, without choosing new scope-matching behavior.

summary: Corrected the hostname-only originAllowlist example with a red-to-green regression (exit 1 before, exit 0 after; 2/2 pass). Build/typecheck, retained Node regressions (31/31) and the full Vitest suite (248 files, 2764 tests) all exit 0. Six needs-human contract/acceptance findings remain, so fixed=false; browser enforcement and remote CI remain unverified.
